events.note: After scene 124, recruit Kurtz with Virose and the original three upgrade levels if the original ending has not recruited him.
Build Super Earthgain after scene 124 once both pilots and parts are present. Set the joined outcome for the following scenes so Brad stays with Earthgain.

title.ja: スーパーアースゲイン

text.ja: このステージをクリアするとカーツが仲間になり、スーパーアースゲインで出撃できる。マップ上で分離・合体できる
text.zh-Hans: 通关本话后卡茨入队，超级夺地者可出击，地图上可以分离、再合体
text.zh-Hant: 通關本話後卡茨入隊，超級奪地者可出擊，地圖上可以分離、再合體
text.en: Clear this stage to recruit Kurtz and deploy Super Earthgain. It can separate and combine again on the map
text.ko: 이 스테이지를 클리어하면 카츠가 합류하고 슈퍼 어스게인으로 출격할 수 있다. 맵에서 분리·합체할 수 있다
